reason: Zahir Insight - retur penjualan per faktur (subsider parent = faktur, child = retur, kelompok 32) untuk Daftar Tagihan Jatuh Tempo
name: retur_faktur
query:
SELECT G1.parent_id, G1.no_faktur, G1.retur_id, G1.no_retur, G1.d AS tanggal, G1.contact_id, G1.total FROM (
  SELECT
    s.parent_id                         AS parent_id,      -- faktur penjualan (g_jurnal.id)
    inv.nojurnal                        AS no_faktur,
    r.id                                AS retur_id,
    r.nojurnal                          AS no_retur,
    r.tanggal::date                     AS d,
    inv.contact_id                      AS contact_id,
    COALESCE(s.total, 0)::numeric(18,2) AS total
  FROM subsider s
  JOIN g_jurnal r   ON r.id = s.child_id AND r.kelompok = 32 AND r.status = 'approved'   -- retur penjualan
  JOIN g_jurnal inv ON inv.id = s.parent_id
) G1
WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
ORDER BY G1.parent_id, G1.d, G1.no_retur {andOrder} {limit}
